The patient's symptoms could also be related to extrapyramidal symptoms, which are a known side effect of haloperidol treatment.
The patient's restlessness and difficulty controlling tongue movements could be indicative of akathisia, a type of extrapyramidal symptom.
The patient's symptoms of involuntary muscle contractions could be related to dystonia, a movement disorder that can be caused by haloperidol treatment.
The patient's symptoms of rigidity and bradykinesia could be indicative of parkinsonism, a side effect of haloperidol treatment.
